instruction: Two Storey Portal Hall Retrofit IFC This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. Modify the starting model into a larger portal-frame hall with a mezzanine office and save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes. 2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 2 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, 2 IfcRoof entities, 15 IfcColumn entities, and 7 IfcBeam entities. 5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcCurtainWall, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, and 0 IfcStair entities. 6. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token hall at least once and the token office at least once. 7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the exact space name mezzanine office at least once. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
